s.note: Salmon, avocado and cucumber rolled in nori, with soy and pickled ginger
s.how: Cook 300g sushi rice and season with rice vinegar and sugar. Spread over 4 nori sheets, lay 200g sliced salmon, avocado and cucumber along each and roll tight. Slice with a wet knife and serve with soy and pickled ginger.

s.note: Pan-fried cabbage and mushroom gyoza with a soy and rice vinegar dipping sauce
s.how: Salt the cabbage, leave 10 minutes, then squeeze out the water. Mix the cabbage, mushrooms, spring onions, ginger, garlic, 1 tbsp soy sauce and the sesame oil. Put a teaspoon of filling on each wrapper, wet the edge and pleat it closed. Fry the gyoza flat side down in the oil for 2 minutes, add 80ml water, cover and steam 4 minutes, then uncover until crisp again. Mix the rest of the soy sauce with the rice vinegar for dipping.

m.note: Grilled chicken thighs in a sticky teriyaki glaze, jasmine rice, bok choy
m.how: Marinate 1kg chicken thighs in 60ml soy, 60ml honey, 2 tbsp chicken stock and 2 tbsp sugar for an hour. Grill until charred, then reduce the marinade to a glaze and brush over. Serve with 300g jasmine rice and steamed bok choy.

w.note: Buttery cookies with a thumbprint of raspberry jam
w.how: Beat 125g soft butter with 80g caster sugar until pale, then add 1 egg yolk and half a tsp vanilla. Mix in 180g plain flour to a soft dough. Roll into 20 balls, place on a lined tray and press a deep hole in each with your thumb. Fill with half a teaspoon of raspberry jam. Bake at 180C for 14 minutes, cool on the tray and dust with icing sugar.

w.note: Shaved ice with homemade lemon syrup, eat it fast
w.how: Simmer 150g caster sugar with 150ml water and the juice and zest of 3 lemons for 5 minutes, then chill. Crush or shave 1kg ice, pack it into 4 cups and pour the lemon syrup over the top. Eat fast before it melts.

d.note: Pineapple, mango and lemon blended with ice, topped with fizzy lemon sherbet
d.how: Blend 600ml cold pineapple juice, 1 chopped mango, the juice of 2 lemons and 4 cups of ice until thick and slushy. Pour into 4 clear glasses or jars. Sprinkle 1 tsp lemon sherbet over each so it fizzes, and serve straight away with spoon straws.
